description: Create a category on a connected WordPress site and return {id, name, slug, created}; created=false means a category with that name already existed (no duplicate is made). Use the id in create_post categories. 403 means the WordPress user connected to Flomixy may not create categories (WORDPRESS_TERM_CREATE_FORBIDDEN). Only create what the user asked for: check list_wordpress_categories first. Requires scope ACCOUNTS_WRITE (a key issued before that scope existed must be re-issued).

accountId.description: The WordPress site account id (list_accounts, channel WORDPRESS).

name.description: Category name, 1-200 characters. An existing name (case-insensitive) is returned as is, never duplicated.

parent.description: Parent category id (from list_wordpress_categories) to create a sub-category. Omit for a top-level category.

name: create_wordpress_category
title: Create WordPress category
